skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: The Nursing Home Creepshow
skins.content: Storyboard Breaker Serialized Comic [Beyond Redemption] Final Character Art/The Nursing Home Creepshow. Outfit of the Dark Forest's therapist in the story. Holding poison in her right hand, her fingertips curled towards her subtle smile, making others wonder if those heavy chains are of any use.
skins.quote: Disappearances, odd deaths, clues that lead into the unknown. In the Dark Forest, by the light of the blood-red moon, the detective hears the name of the 'Hospital of Horror' for the very first time, straight from the smiling therapist's lips.
